candidates.description: This vector represents tokens associated with the Thai language and script.

This feature vector represents the medical concepts of tuberculosis and its common abbreviation "TB," mixed with unrelated Thai script and English character fragments due to noise or subword tokenization.
This feature vector activates on subword tokens and fragments associated with the Thai language and script.
This vector is related to biochemical terms and molecules, specifically encompassing concepts like nucleic acids and lipids.
This vector represents prepositions, conjunctions, and structural grammatical particles across both Thai and English text.
This feature vector activates on common medical prefixes, suffixes, and pharmaceutical terminology across multiple languages.
This vector activates in contexts related to biological organisms, genetics, and medical treatments.
This vector activates on Thai words related to quantification, plurality, and modifiers indicating amount or scale.
This feature vector activates on tokens and subwords related to Thai language text and medical contexts.
This feature vector activates on terms, abbreviations, and scripts associated with the World Health Organization (WHO) and global public health topics such as COVID-19 and pneumonia.
